{{Quote|…it's just me and my mother.|Jai Kell, on his family|<ref name="Breaking Ranks" />}}
In the [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Jai Kell]] lived with his '''mother''' on [[Lothal]]. He later joined the [[Academy for Young Imperials]] on the [[planet]], where the leadership recognized he may have been [[Force-sensitive]] and gave his name to [[the Grand Inquisitor]]. [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Zare Leonis]] learned about this information and helped Kell to escape from the Academy. As a result of the dangers posed by his escape, the [[Spectres|rebels]] agreed to help Kell and his [[Parent|mother]] go into hiding.<ref name="Breaking Ranks" />
